column1: # The frozen corpus for the #84 UNKNOWN-rate measurement. One row per trial.
# Fixed before any sweep run (PR order proves it: this file merges in the
# apparatus PR, the artifacts merge in the results PR).
#   trial_id  group(A|B|control)  tool  class  judge  launcher  args  artdir  report_path  defines
# class slugs map to docs/target-classes.md rows: c-cpp-cli="C/C++ CLI",
# c-cli="C CLI", cxx-cli="C++ CLI", python-cli="Python CLI",
# python-sqlite="Python + sqlite", perl-cli="Perl CLI"; shell-helper is the
# control's behavioral class (not a supported class). B-group class slugs
# come from the archive's own implemented-in debtag.
# judge: l0=built-in atomicity only, l0c=+declared checker.
# launcher "-" with args W1|W2|W3 is a funnel wall: no engine run, the
# grounds are in defines-b/<tool>/NOTES.md (rules in docs/unknown-rate.md).
# defines: ;-separated repo-relative paths (a directory means every file
# under it, sorted) — hashed into the sweep manifest.
